newsitem.title: USA: Cummins Engine names Indonesian licensee.
newsitem.headline: Cummins Engine names Indonesian licensee.

text.p: Cummins Engine Co said Tuesday it has licensed PT Perkasa Heavyndo to produce engines in Indonesia.
The engines will be used initially to power mid-size and heavy-duty trucks produced through an integrated manufacturing project being undertaken by Heavyndo, Cummins said.
The initial investment will provide a capacity for 30,000 engines annually, which eventually could increase to an annual capacity for 50,000 engines, the company said.

Included in the agreement is the option for Heavyndo's parent company, Texmaco Jaya PT and Cummins to form a joint venture to take advantage of fast-developing markets in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, the company said.
Heavyndo will produce the B Series engine at a plant in Subang on the island of Java beginning next year, Cummins said.
Cummins shares fell 1/4 to 45 on Tuesday.
